images.seen: A runner on a wet forest road, the tall gum trees rising and disappearing into fog overhead. Saturday.
lines: The trees go up about thirty metres and then just stop existing.
The forest is keeping its top half private this morning.
The road is the only thing committing to a direction this morning.

images.seen: A golf ball sitting in wet rough in close-up, a golfer with his bag fading into heavy fog behind it. Sunday.
lines: Found: one ball. The other three hundred metres of golf course are still missing.
The fairway is out there somewhere, taking the morning off from being visible.
Fog gives every golfer the same handicap, and today it is generous.

images.seen: A tabby cat sitting on a brick garden wall, two ghostly human figures deep in the fog behind it, a Victorian house barely visible. Monday.
lines: The cat can see exactly what is in that fog and is choosing not to say.
The neighbours are out there somewhere, at about ten percent opacity.
Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.

images.seen: A Land Rover with headlights blazing on a misty lowveld road at dusk, acacia trees in layered fog, wet tar. Monday.
lines: The bushveld has gone soft-focus and the Landy is taking it slowly.
Headlights do about twenty metres out here; the rest is memory and respect.
Mist off the veld at dusk: the road home just doubled in length.
